import re

async def act(page):
    # Try to find a filter button or link to open filter options
    filter_button = page.get_by_role('button', name=re.compile(r'filter|author|date', re.IGNORECASE))
    if await filter_button.count() > 0:
        await filter_button.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for filter UI to appear
    else:
        # If no button, look for a link or other element that might trigger filters
        filter_link = page.get_by_role('link', name=re.compile(r'filter|author|date', re.IGNORECASE))
        if await filter_link.count() > 0:
            await filter_link.first.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        else:
            # Check for input fields that might be for filtering
            author_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name=re.compile(r'author', re.IGNORECASE))
            if await author_input.count() > 0:
                await author_input.first.click()
                await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            else:
                # If no filter elements found, log and wait to see if page has more content
                print('No filter controls found. Checking for other elements.')
                await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    # Wait for any dynamic content to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
